patterns.name: firstRead
patterns.application: (getValue_success readFuel uv before readAfter (.unenumerated (some oldHandle) scs)).mp observed

fields.name: _lookup
fields.type: UnionFind.findRoot readFuel before.representatives uv = some found

patterns.name: actualFallback
patterns.application: fits admits (holeKey metadata.typing uv) heap before readAfter entry readFuel uv oldHandle scs ready realized total observed entered

fields.name: innerNarrowed
fields.type: SourcePruningNativeView.narrowAt fits admits nativeFuel (holeKey metadata.typing uv) innerOld heap = .done result nextHeap

fields.name: innerStable
fields.type: ∀ extra, SourcePruningNativeView.narrowAt fits admits (nativeFuel + extra) (holeKey metadata.typing uv) innerOld heap = .done result nextHeap

fields.name: emptyBranch
fields.type: result = .empty → ¬ ∃ final : EnumerationState.State Symbol EnumGuard, Success (reject : EnumerateM Symbol EnumGuard Unit) entry () final

fields.name: equalBranch
fields.type: result ≠ .empty → newHandle = oldHandle → result = innerOld ∧ Success (pure () : EnumerateM Symbol EnumGuard Unit) entry () entry

fields.name: changedBranch
fields.type:
result ≠ .empty → newHandle ≠ oldHandle →
  ∃ (root size rereadFuel : Nat) (rereadAfter final : EnumerationState.State Symbol EnumGuard),
    UnionFind.Reaches before.representatives uv root size ∧
    Success (representative rereadFuel uv) entry root rereadAfter ∧
    Frame entry rereadAfter ∧ Frame before rereadAfter ∧
    rereadAfter.values[root]? = some (.unenumerated (some oldHandle) scs) ∧
    root < rereadAfter.values.length ∧ PendingRealized nextHeap rereadAfter ∧
    Success (setValue root (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)) rereadAfter () final ∧
    final = {rereadAfter with values := rereadAfter.values.set root (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)} ∧
    final.values[root]? = some (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs) ∧ PendingRealized nextHeap final ∧
    Success (representative rereadFuel uv >>= fun selected =>
      setValue selected (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)) entry () final
